evidence: Figure 1 : Motivation and overview of ReFocus. (a) Sparse terminal rewards reveal little about partial progress or task-specific bottlenecks. (b) ReFocus uses progress feedback to guide targeted practice through alternation of Global RL and Local RL. (c) ReFocus achieves success rates of 98.3% on three real-world long-horizon tasks, compared with 81.7% for RECAP [ 1 ] . (d) ReFocus raises the success rates of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 5 ] from 90.6% to 97.8% on LIBERO-Long and from 39.3% to 51.3% on RoboCasa365.
